Synopsis:
The US-Canada trade war is escalating sharply. The US has banned Canadian dairy, alcohol and motorcycles, and is excluding Canadian products from large federal government contracts. Canada retaliated with tariffs on ~$20bn of US imports across a broad range of goods. Canada's stated strategy is to reduce US dependence and diversify trade internationally. Formal negotiations have collapsed, with both sides signalling no imminent concession. The conflict is deepening an already severe rupture between two historically close allies.
